messages:
sara: quick sync — we need to lock the Q2 pricing/quota approach today. customer asks keep coming for 'per-route' caps and smoother trial bursts. what are non-negotiables?
jorge: +1. Recurring asks from ecommerce & search teams: per-route TPS and token caps, and clearer overage calc. customers confused by 'credits' behavior.
amanda: we should avoid exploding complexity. propose 3 primitives: 1) global quota, 2) route-level soft caps (warn then throttle), 3) burst credits bucket for trials.
kevin: for soft caps, suggest policy: 95th pctile per-route sliding window, warn at 80%, soft throttle at 95% for 30s. keeps latency SLO.
priya: customers also want auto-failover to cheaper model instead of throttle. can we include model-fallback policy in the spec?
sara: good call. include fallback as a configurable policy: fallback_model or queue_until_capacity. default: fallback_model to "redwood-base-1" to avoid errors.
jorge: pricing impact: bursts + generous trial credits could cannibalize usage. need revenue guardrails: trial credits redeemable only up to X% of first-month bill?
amanda: I like a usage-window on trial credits: 14 days expire and caps at 50k tokens. keeps it simple.
kevin: implementation note: we can reuse the existing quota engine. config example: ```yaml
quota_policies:
  - name: route_soft_cap
    scope: route
    window: 60s
    warn_threshold: 0.8
    throttle_threshold: 0.95
  - name: trial_burst
    scope: account
    tokens: 50000
    expires_in: 14d
```
priya: testing & launch criteria? we need metrics: fewer than 1% unexpected throttles, revenue delta < 2% after 2 weeks, and <0.5% customer escalations.
sara: proposed rollout plan: spec -> internal spike -> canary (5% of accounts) -> ramp with telemetry gates -> GA. canary gates: error rate, throttle counts, revenue signal.
jorge: add a safety net: automatic rollback if throttle rate > 3x baseline or error rate increase > 0.5pp.
amanda: ops question: who owns alerts? SRE for infra alarms, product for policy regressions. assignable runbook needed.
kevin: I'll draft the runbook and add automation for rolling back the new quota config via the console API.
priya: for customer communication: update docs + e-mail for large customers with migration steps and sample configs. also add UI hints in Console (explain trial tokens).
sara: decision points: 1) trial token size & expiry (amanda proposal), 2) soft cap thresholds (kevin numbers), 3) fallback default model (priyaa? agreed is redwood-base-1). approve?
jorge: approve with the revenue guardrail caveat — let's run revenue sim on the proposed defaults before canary.
amanda: approve.
kevin: approve, will start spike this week.
priya: approve. I'll own comms + docs.
ops-bot: Reminder: spec doc created at https://redwood/intern/docs/q2-pricing-quota-draft (draft-1).
sara: thanks. action items: kevin spike, jo rge revenue sim, priya comms + doc updates, amanda finalize trial limit language. I'll schedule 30m follow-up on Friday. :memo:
jorge: noted.
kevin: starting spike now, will post results to the thread.
priya: will prepare migration checklist and customer email template by Thursday.
amanda: will write the trial policy blurb and edge cases (shared accounts, refunds).
sara: perfect. if anyone finds a blocker ping me directly.
